description: This Java source file defines the HttpEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and handles both synchronous and asynchronous execution of services via HTTP. It includes methods for serializing/deserializing service contexts, making HTTP requests, and handling HTTP service invocations within a servlet environment.

classes.name: HttpEngine
classes.description: A class responsible for executing services over HTTP, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous dispatch, and handling HTTP requests within a servlet environment.

methods.description: Constructor initializing HttpEngine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, serializing the context, performing an HTTP POST request, and deserializing the response.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes runSync and ignores exceptions, used for fire-and-forget scenarios.

methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests to invoke services, including context deserialization, service invocation (sync or async), and response serialization.
